source_excerpt: Shikhar Mohan called up to India A squad for last two red-ball matches against New Zealand A left File photo- Its a well-deserved call-up for the 21-year-old, considering his recent impressive form in the domestic circuit. PTI PTI https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/a0r9qi/article71614857.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/PTI09_09_2026_000189A.jpg R SENTHILKUMAR Chennai: East Zone's Shikhar Mohan plays a shot on day 4 of the Duleep Trophy 2026-27 final cricket match between South Zone and East Zone, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, Wednesday, Sept. 9, 2026. (PTI Photo/R Senthilkumar)(PTI09_09_2026_000189A) Chennai Shikhar will play alongside Test regulars K.L. Rahul, Washington Sundar, Dhruv Jurel, Devdutt Padikkal, and Sai Sudharsan. Jharkhand batter Shikhar Mohan has been included in the India A squad for the last two four-day matches against New Zealand A. Shikhar will play alongside Test regulars K.L. Rahul, Washington Sundar, Dhruv Jurel, Devdutt Padikkal, and Sai Sudharsan. Shikhar has started his Ranji Trophy campaign with back-to-back centuries against Kerala and Maharashtra. Prior to that, Shikhar scored twin half-centuries in the Duleep Trophy final to help East Zone lift the title. Shikhar also scored 60 for Rest of India against Jammu and Kashmir in the Irani Cup. The first red-ball game between India A and New Zealand A will begin on October 26 Lincoln, followed by the second and third games in Christchurch and Lincoln again respectively. India A updated squad for New Zealand A red-ball series Yashasvi Jaiswal, KL Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, R Smaran, Kumar Kushagra (wk), Dhruv Jurel (capt, wk), Washington Sundar, Auqib Nabi, Akash Deep, Anshul Kamboj, Manav Suthar, Mukesh Choudhary, B Sai Sudharsan, Yash Rathod, Mukesh Kumar, Rishabh Pant (subject to fitness), Shikhar Mohan (for the last two matches)
